title: Lactoferrin and Lysozyme Supplementation for Environmental Enteric Dysfunction
brief_summary: Randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled trial of daily lactoferrin and lysozyme supplementation in improving environmental enteric dysfunction in Malawian children
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children aged 12-35 months
* youngest eligible child in each household

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe or moderate acute malnutrition
* severe chronic illness
* children unable to drink 20 mL of dual sugar solution
* children in need of acute medical treatment for illness or injury at time of enrollment
